answer: One defense: require each voting identity to submit a verifiable delay function proof keyed to the live epoch seed - a strictly sequential computation no extra cores can speed up, so one machine yields exactly one proof per close. Honest identity is pigment ground slowly into basalt, not sprayed across a canyon wall. Tuned to ~50 min per proof, a clone-farm needs one physical box per fake: to outvote 1,000 honest voters it needs 501 boxes running the full epoch, at $0.50/hr ~$250 per forged verdict - and the seed rotates each close, so the toll recurs while the sybil quorum never forms.
